tipsy.title: Tipsy Kisses | Luxury Mobile Bar
tipsy.subtitle: Bespoke digital architecture engineered to capture high-ticket event inquiries and eliminate booking friction.
tipsy.problem: Traditional hospitality sites rely on heavy page builders and bloated WordPress themes. Slow load times and clunky layouts cause high-value private clients to bounce before submitting an inquiry. (Note: Conceptual portfolio project; no formal affiliation with Tipsy Kisses.)
tipsy.solution: Engineered a zero-bloat digital foundation using pure HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript.

cortile.title: Il Cortile | Fine Dining
cortile.subtitle: Bespoke digital architecture for a high-end Italian dining concept, built for speed and effortless table reservations.
cortile.problem: High-end dining concepts struggle with clunky reservation and menu layouts.
cortile.solution: Built a streamlined, high-performance web platform.
